hints.title: Metric Aggregation per Driver
hints.text: Join Vehicles, Trips, and Drivers. Group by fuel_type and driver_id to compute total distance and average rating rounded to 2 decimal places.

hints.title: Multi-Criteria Window Ranking
hints.text: Partition by fuel_type using window ranking ordered by rating descending, distance descending, and accidents ascending.

hints.title: Top Rank Filtering
hints.text: Filter for rows where rnk = 1 and order the final output by fuel_type ascending.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH DriverStats AS (
    SELECT 
        v.fuel_type,
        d.driver_id,
        ROUND(AVG(t.rating), 2) AS rating,
        SUM(t.distance) AS distance,
        d.accidents
    FROM Vehicles v
    JOIN Trips t ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id
    JOIN Drivers d ON v.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY v.fuel_type, d.driver_id, d.accidents
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        fuel_type,
        driver_id,
        rating,
        distance,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY fuel_type 
            ORDER BY rating DESC, distance DESC, accidents ASC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM DriverStats
)
SELECT fuel_type, driver_id, rating, distance
FROM Ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY fuel_type ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Hash join between tables, grouping by fuel type and driver, followed by window ranking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries for multi-criterion tie-breaking become slow and error-prone.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(T + V + D) memory for intermediate hash joins.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses CTE with multi-tier tie-breaking window ranking partitioned by fuel type.
